businesses.business: online dating and social connection apps

offering_description.value: Operates mobile dating and social networking apps, including Bumble, Badoo and BFF, for consumers seeking romantic, friendship and networking connections. Users download free apps and pay for premium features and in-app purchases. Delivered through app stores and web.

primary_products.value: dating apps; friendship and social networking apps; premium subscription features; in-app consumables

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers using dating and friend-finding apps

end_markets.value: online dating; social networking; consumer mobile apps

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring premium app subscriptions for enhanced features; transaction or usage fees: in-app purchases such as boosts, credits and consumable features; advertising: limited advertising and partnership revenue in apps
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and runs dating app platforms, selling to individual consumers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia and other markets worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: Bumble, Badoo and BFF apps for dating and social connection

distribution_channels.value: online: mobile app stores (Apple, Google) and web

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules (GDPR, CCPA), online safety regulation, app store and consumer subscription rules
